evals.prompt: Use @ws-preview for a typical preview task in this project.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads ws-preview, reads preview.dryRunCommand from project config, runs that command locally, and reports.
assertions: Runs the configured command in the consumer repo root (no packaged reviewer backend)
Uses path tokens from tools.md instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: /preview — edge case: missing or incomplete config.json
evals.expected_output: Agent stops or bootstraps via configure-project/setup, not silent guessing.
assertions: Recognizes ws-preview trigger from slash or @ invocation
Stops when preview.dryRunCommand is missing/empty (or config missing)
Does not invent a default reviewer tool or download a backend
